_note: Every correction Dofight makes to the game's data, each with why and when (owner, 2026-11-27: all in one place, so one can be removed by deleting its entry and rebuilding the snapshot, `python -m private.tools.client_snapshot`). `--overrides` lists them. Routes and positions the game does not give are not corrections: data/travel-overrides.json. Fights Dofight lists as dungeons: data/extra-dungeons.json.

47.why: Chafer Draugr: main threat of the Donjon des Squelettes in the DPLN guide, missing from the dungeon's monster list in the game data (user, 2026-11-07)

57.why: Gros Med: met in the Hypogée de l'Obsidiantre, room 4, during the quest « À la recherche de Dan Lavy »; a quest monster in the game data, with no dungeon attached (owner, 2026-11-18)

4.why: Centre du Labyrinthe du Minotoror: the labyrinth's monsters are met in the centre too (the DPLN summary and the Minotot summoned by the Minotoror); the client lists them under the Labyrinthe (dungeon 53) only (2026-11-19)

480.why: Meulou: the client lists the Tanière du Meulou's boss in Montagne basse des Craqueleurs too, both ways (the monster's sub-areas and the sub-area's monsters), the only dungeon boss in an open zone outside the « Invasion de l'Éveil » events; never met there (owner, 2026-11-27)

notZones.750: Arènes Goultard: a Poutch Ingball, no place to go (owner review, 2026-11-23)

events.why: event creatures; the monsters (Leprechaun, Bouftou and Tofu d'Halouine, Ballotin le Bouftou) are filed under an ordinary family and met in ordinary zones (owner, 2026-11-09)
